SandboxReset.//: PLAT003A/B — both flags default OFF (fail closed). 'Enabled' activates the destructive reset (requires registered tenant-store purgers, wired by PLAT003C). 'Scheduler.Enabled' turns on the nightly sandbox-reset-scheduler cron tick; while 'Enabled' is false the scheduled tick is a safe no-op. Targets are reset only if they are resettable sandboxes (guarded from stored metadata).
